title: The CloudFormation template for the AWS DLP integration: required AWS permissions, parameters, defaults, conditions and stack outputs

prose.text: Defaults for the SNS topic name and the object lock retention mode are not on the page {{gap:unstated-defaults}}. The overview is [[zwa.aws-dlp-integration]], and the same resources created by hand are in [[zwa.aws-dlp-integration.manual-setup]].

checks.do: Whether the AWS user creating the stack holds the minimum permissions the page lists.
Whether encryptBuckets and encryptTopic were set to true and allowKMSKeyCreate to false, since kmsArnS3 and kmsArnSNS apply only then.
Whether the bucketNamePrefix is within 40 characters and has no dots.

minimum-permissions.statement: To create the CloudFormation stack the AWS user needs, at a minimum, AmazonS3FullAccess (data and metadata buckets), AWSKeyManagementServicePowerUser (KMS key for the SNS topic message encryption), IAMFullAccess or a custom IAM policy with Create Role and Create Policy (cross-account policy for accessing the S3 bucket), and AmazonSNSFullAccess (SNS topic).

quotes: Ensure that you have the following list of permissions in AWS, at a minimum, to successfully create the CloudFormation stack:
| AmazonS3FullAccess | To create the data and metadata bucket for uploading incidents and incident metadata. |
| AWSKeyManagementServicePowerUser | To create the Key Management Service (KMS) Key for encrypting the message in the Simple Notification Service (SNS) topic. |
| IAMFullAccess or Custom IAM Policy with permission to Create Role and Create Policy | To create a cross-account policy for accessing the S3 bucket.
| AmazonSNSFullAccess | To create an SNS topic.

zwa-parameters.statement: The Zscaler-specific parameters zwaAccountID, zwaRole and customerGuid are copied from the Account Settings page; zwaRole restricts the integration to that role in the Workflow Automation AWS account.

quotes: zwaAccountID: Copy the AWS Account from the Account Settings page in the Zscaler Admin Console and enter it here. This parameter is the Workflow Automation AWS account.
zwaRole: Copy the Role Name from the Account Settings page in the Zscaler Admin Console and enter it here.
This enables the integration to be restricted to only this role in your Workflow Automation AWS account.
customerGuid: Copy the Customer Globally Unique Identifier (GUID) from the Account Settings page in the Zscaler Admin Console and enter it here.

zia-role-arn.statement: The ziaRoleARN parameter is the only role allowed to write S3 objects for the S3 bucket policy; it is the ZIR role ARN on the Incident Receiver page and the Cloud-to-Cloud role ARN on the Cloud-to-Cloud page.

quotes: ziaRoleARN: Enter the ZIR Role Amazon Resource Name (ARN), which is the only role allowed to write S3 objects for the S3 bucket policy.
ziaRoleARN: Enter the Cloud-to-Cloud Role Amazon Resource Name (ARN), which is the only role allowed to write S3 objects for the S3 bucket policy.

bucket-name-prefix.statement: The bucketNamePrefix parameter can be up to 40 characters and must not contain dots.

quotes: The prefix can be up to 40 characters. Ensure that you do not use dots (.) in the name prefix.

encryption-defaults.statement: The encryptBuckets and encryptTopic parameters default to false.

quotes: encryptBuckets: Select true to enable KMS encryption on both S3 buckets with KMS keys. By default, false appears.
encryptTopic: Select true to enable KMS encryption on the SNS topic with KMS keys. By default, false appears.

kms-arn-conditions.statement: kmsArnS3 applies only when encryptBuckets is true and allowKMSKeyCreate is false; kmsArnSNS applies only when encryptTopic is true and allowKMSKeyCreate is false.

quotes: kmsArnS3: This parameter only applies if you select true for the encryptBuckets parameter in this section, and you select false in the allowKMSKeyCreate parameter in the KMS Encryption Configuration parameters section.

kmsArnSNS: This parameter only applies if you select true for the encryptTopic parameter in this section, and you select false in the allowKMSKeyCreate parameter in the KMS Encryption Configuration parameters section.

allow-kms-key-create.statement: allowKMSKeyCreate (default false) lets the stack create a KMS key linked to the S3 buckets and SNS topic; it only applies when both encryptBuckets and encryptTopic are true.

quotes: In the KMS Encryption Configuration parameters section, in the allowKMSKeyCreate field, select true to enable the CloudFormation stack script to create a KMS key and link that key to the S3 buckets and the SNS topic for encryption. By default, false appears.

This parameter only applies if you select true for the encryptBuckets parameter in the S3 Configuration parameters section and the encryptTopic parameter in the SNS Topic Configuration parameters section.

object-lock.statement: lockRententionMode selects Governance or Compliance retention for Object Lock-protected object versions, and lockRententionDays (default 180) is the number of days an object remains locked.

quotes: lockRententionMode: From the drop-down menu, select the retention mode for any object version that is protected by Object Lock. Retention modes are Governance and Compliance.
lockRententionDays: Enter the number of days during which an object remains locked. By default, 180 appears.

cloudtrail.statement: enableCloudtrail (default false) enables S3 data events in CloudTrail; cloudTrailLogsBucket applies only when enableCloudtrail is true.

quotes: enableCloudtrail: Select true to enable S3 data events in CloudTrail to capture and audit all activity within the S3 bucket. By default, false appears.
cloudTrailLogsBucket: This parameter only applies if you select true for the enableCloudtrail parameter in this section.

expiration-defaults.statement: enableExpiration defaults to false; expirationDaysCurrent defaults to 365, expirationDaysNonCurrent (permanent deletion of non-current versions) to 60, and incompleteMultipartDays (abort incomplete multipart uploads) to 7.

quotes: enableExpiration: Select true to enable the lifecycle policy to expire objects and clean up versions and multipart uploads. By default, false appears.
expirationDaysCurrent: Enter the number of days after which the current object versions expire. By default, 365 appears.
expirationDaysNonCurrent: Enter the number of days after which the non-current versions are permanently deleted. By default, 60 appears.
incompleteMultipartDays: Enter the number of days after which incomplete multipart uploads are aborted. By default, 7 appears.

role-defaults.statement: enableReadAccessToDataBucket (default true) gives the integration account read access to the data bucket.

quotes: enableReadAccessToDataBucket: Select true to enable the integration account to have read access to the data bucket. By default, true appears.

stack-options.statement: On the Configure stack options page the Stack failure options and Advanced options keep their defaults, and the I acknowledge that AWS CloudFormation might create IAM resources with custom names checkbox must be selected.

quotes: In the next sections (Stack failure options and Advanced options) on the page, leave the default values.
select the I acknowledge that AWS CloudFormation might create IAM resources with custom names checkbox.

stack-outputs.statement: Stack creation starts as CREATE_IN_PROGRESS and ends as CREATE_COMPLETE; the Outputs tab gives the IAM cross-account role ARN and external ID, SNS topic ARN, support role ARN (if created) and S3 bucket name prefix, which are required when adding the integration in Workflow Automation.

quotes: Initially, the stack creation status is CREATE_IN_PROGRESS.
the status changes to CREATE_COMPLETE.
Click the Outputs tab to view the IAM cross-account role ARN and the external ID, SNS topic ARN, support role ARN (if created), and S3 bucket name prefix (copied from input) outputs.
They are required when adding a DLP Application Integration in Workflow Automation.

unstated-defaults.title: What are the default SNS topic name and the default lockRententionMode?
unstated-defaults.detail: The page says 'The default SNS topic name appears in the field' for snsTopicName without giving the name, and does not state which retention mode (Governance or Compliance) is preselected for lockRententionMode.
